headline: Proposed 2027 facility fee schedule, Old Mountain Field and Saugatucket Park projects, and Wakefield and South Road school demolition status.
summary: The agenda covers the proposed 2027 facility fee schedule and updates on the Old Mountain Field and Saugatucket Park projects. It also includes a review of the administration section of the 2026-2027 policy manual and the status of the Wakefield Elementary School and South Road School demolition.
items: Thank you note from S Enos about bike path maintenance
Old Mountain Field capital improvement project status
Saugatucket Park lighting project status report
Review of the administration section of the 2026-2027 policy and administrative manual
Status of Wakefield Elementary School and South Road School demolition
location: The Neighborhood Guild, 325 Columbia St., Peace Dale, RI
